text: {"assertions":["A corrupted scaffold bug in cli/commands/init.py caused a generated tree to be missing one file.","The bug only became apparent after a rolling restart of the fleet.","The root cause was an error being swallowed by a bare except statement.","The fix involved narrowing the exception handler to let the failure propagate, implemented in PR #6320 on branch fix/corrupted-scaffold-1.","The bug can be reproduced by running the init command in a directory that already contains a lockfile.","After applying the fix, cold start time improved to 355 milliseconds, a 16 percent reduction."]}
